roo.description: The best free models to get started

landing.introduction: Built with the most powerful models, designed for high-quality engineering delivery. 12 work modes, automating the entire workflow end-to-end from design and development to packaging and compilation. Let AI become your superpower for productivity.
landing.accountMention: To get started, create your tocodex-Community account. Get powerful models, high-quality engineering, cost analysis, and more.

providerSignup.heading: Choose your provider
providerSignup.chooseProvider: tocodex-Community needs an LLM provider to work. Choose one to get started, you can add more later.
providerSignup.rooCloudDescription: The easiest way to start is with tocodex-Community: a curated mix of free and paid models at a low cost.
providerSignup.useAnotherProviderDescription: Enter an API key and get going.
providerSignup.noApiKeys: Don't want to deal with API keys and separate accounts?

waitingForCloud.heading: Logging into tocodex-Community...
waitingForCloud.description: We'll take you to your browser to sign up for tocodex-Community. We'll then bring you back here to finish.
